response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS count_ratio FROM station_counts ORDER BY count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
